Method of Attack: Deploying remote access trojan (RAT) via Windows Defender SmartScreen zero-day exploit
Social engineering via spearphishing with malicious stock chart linking to compromised trading information site
Bypassing SmartScreen security checks using specially crafted files and nested internet shortcuts (.URL) exploiting Mark-of-the-Web (MotW) bypass
Impacted Systems: Windows systems used by foreign exchange traders
Attack Vector: Spearphishing with malicious files and URLs
Exploitation of Windows Defender SmartScreen zero-day vulnerability CVE-2024-21412
Use of compromised trading information site (fxbulls.ru) impersonating legitimate forex broker platform (fxbulls.com)
Indicators of Compromise: Use of internet shortcuts (.URL) and WebDAV components
